SEN.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.

facts.fact: Polygon says Senegal's chatbot Anta, developed by Sénégal Numérique SA, uses AI intent detection and voice recognition to answer users and guide them through administrative procedures on the Service Public portal.

SEN.note: Anta is a general administration chatbot, not a sector system.
Anta is a use of AI; the document does not say it is a model built or hosted in the country, and names no dataset or compute.
No rural internet programme or rural-urban figure is stated.

facts.fact: Polygon says the Service Public portal of Senegal lists nearly 700 administrative procedures available online, as a single window for information and forms.

SEN.note: No share of people using the internet is given.
Anta is said to be developed by Sénégal Numérique SA, but the document does not say it is a state body running systems for government or that the system went live.
